LESSON: SIGN READING 2.2.3 LETTER RECOGNITION.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Sign Reading 2.2.3 Letter recognition.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 2.2.3 Letter recognition., part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which games do we play with friends at home? 2. Which materials do we use to write and read letters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 2.2.3 Letter recognition. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: Interpretation and inference skills as learner recalls learnt letter sounds.

● Digital literacy: Digital citizenship as learner observes a to signed audio visual clip on letter sounds.

Values:
● Respect: Human dignity as learner chants the letter sounds together with others and appreciates each other’s

contribution.

● Responsibility: Accountability as learner is diligently engaged in assigned roles and duties of chanting letters

sounds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

fishing game)

Link to other Activity Areas:

Chanting of rhymes on letter names is linked sign singing of songs in Creative Activities.

Adapted course book, Signed audio visual story clips, books, flash cards, online resources, video games, charts, pictures,
